title: A landing page builder
oneLine: Marketing pages with a form, without touching code.
why: If you only need a few pages, AI tools build them beautifully and hosting is free. The same person who gave up on the social feed above kept his rebuilt landing pages and cancelled a $250/month tool. What you lose is the drag-and-drop editor and A/B testing.
tool: v0 or Lovable for the page; Cloudflare Pages or Vercel free tier to host
keep: A visual editor for non-technical teammates, A/B tests, integrations.
breaks: Forms. Where does the submission go? Decide that before you start.
